outline:
此門課程的主要目標，將以介紹高等積體電路設計為主，讓學生了解高等積體電路設計的理論、概念、流程及方法。課程將理論與實際並重，讓學生具有實際的高等積體電路設計能力。
1.Introduction of Advanced VLSI Design
2.Introduction and Use of EDA tools (ADFT 16nm FinFET/TN90GUTM/TN65GP)
3.Circuit/System simulation
4.Layout drawing/verifications (DRC, LVS, and Post-Layout Simulation)
schedule:
week  1    Course Introduction
week  2    Process Overview
week  3    Various Inverters
week  4    Design environment
week  5    Simulations
week  6    Layout
week  7    Laker & Calibre DRC/LVS introduction
week  8    Ring oscillator & Flip-flops
week  9    Mid-term project
week 10   Frequency synthesizers
week 11   Arithmetic circuits
week 12   Dynamic logic
week 13-14   Memory
week 15-17   Data converters
week 18   Final project
assessment:
Attendance: 20%
Homework: 20%
Mid-term project: 30%
Final project: 30%
